Rules of action · seven items

Push back on extraction,
and on shrinking back

Of the first two pages, one handles data and one handles concrete situations; this page closes the loop by compressing the criteria into seven rules you can act on. It does not aim at fairness — it aims at nothing going wrong.

Thresholds before appearances A review like a correction notebook 7 rules in total · updated over time
Small-print disclaimer:Items 1 and 2 below are deliberately set to the most conservative risk assumption — what they define isa threshold for self-protection, not an overall judgement about any group. Following this standard has a cost: you will also miss some people with whom things could have developed normally. It is written here because for many people, learning not to lose comes before everything that follows.
Assume the risk exists first

Unless you are "widely known to be so outstanding that most people around you like you", be wary of any woman who approaches you first and tries to steer things towards romance; whatever her personal circumstances, always keep at least 10% guard up (consider the possibility that she is after money).

If one-sided giving appears within a year, leave immediately

On top of item 1: if within a year she clearly shows that she needs you to keep spending real money one-sidedly, find a way out at once. It calls for a saturated sense of crisis warning, even at the cost of the tiny chance that "she is genuinely a good person".

The makeup of her circle is information too

For any woman whose circle has a very heavy "xxn" element, keep our relationship at nothing more than "just chatting, with no other contact" — this is the one case where getting close is least advisable.

Never reveal how much you need it.
Put loving yourself first; it needs no justification

In this life the ones you truly "ought" to love are your parents and yourself; if your parents were not up to the task, then only yourself. Putting yourself first needs no justification, and do not fear moral blackmail or public condemnation when treating yourself.

You no.1 bro.
Push back on extraction — and on shrinking back

For the many more "Pangmaos" who may appear in the future, absorb and summarise what happened to those involved into concrete experience; in your thinking, resist both extraction and shrinking back. All of this is a correction notebook for the road ahead.

Share notes with people like you

For more detail, join the Baidu Tieba board "You Nan Bu Wan ML" to talk about these topics with others.

Let us encourage each other

With a shared goal, the road is never lonely;
The rights that should be ours in the future must be won by ourselves.

Last page · the other side

The relationship I want

The rules are about nothing going wrong; this page is about what you actually want: financial independence, taking turns paying, an open relationship, equal emotional investment, honesty and transparency. Real love makes you a better version of yourself, not servile, anxious or poor.
